name: postlinkly/teme
label: Postlinkly
description: Suggests internal links to your published articles while you write, using words already in your text. You choose which links to add.
author: Krafty Sprouts Media, LLC

settings.label: Suggestions at a time
settings.description: The most link suggestions Find links offers for one article.

settings.label: Paragraphs to leave alone
settings.description: How many paragraphs at the start of an article never get a suggested link.

settings.label: Words to ignore
settings.description: Words that should never count as a reason to link, one per line. Common words like "the" are already ignored in each language.
